🔮 On the Horizon.title: A Long-Run Persistence Theory for AI Systems under the Redundancy-Adjusted Artificial Age Score (AAS)
🔮 On the Horizon.summary: This paper develops a long-run persistence theory for AI systems, addressing the question of whether an AI system can persist indefinitely without incurring unbounded structural aging.

🔮 On the Horizon.title: The LLM Proposes, the Executive Disposes: A Self-Verifying Agent Instrument that Dissociates Commitment Drift from Binding Drift in Long-Horizon Agents
🔮 On the Horizon.summary: This paper presents an agent instrument that verifies long-horizon agents by dissociating commitment drift from binding drift.

🔮 On the Horizon.title: Monte Carlo Tree Search for Table-to-Multimodal Report Generation
🔮 On the Horizon.summary: This paper proposes a Monte Carlo Tree Search approach for generating professional multimodal reports from structured tabular data.
